Package index

Inference

sequential_estimator()
Computes the unit or cohort level sequential synthetic diff-in-diff or diff-in-diff estimate.
estimation_unit()
#' Computes the unit level sequential synthetic diff-in-diff or diff-in-diff estimate.
estimation_cohort()
Computes the cohort level sequential synthetic diff-in-diff or diff-in-diff estimate.
tau_sdid()
Computes the base synthetic diff-in-diff or diff-in-diff estimate.
base_estimator()
Computes the base synthetic diff-in-diff or diff-in-diff estimate.
estimate_s2()
Estimates the upper bound of the noise variance.
vcov(<sequential_estimate>)
Compute standard errors for the sequential estimator.

Data preparation

to_wide()
Converts a data set into wide panels.
prepare_wide()
Aggregate panel to cohort level or prepare for the unit level.
aggregate_Y()
Aggregate dataframe on adoption_date and covariates.

CHC simulation

estimate_dgp_chc()
Estimate the DGP for CHC simulation.
simulate_dgp_chc()
Simulate the CHC DGP by sampling the noise.

CPS simulation

estimate_dgp()
Estimates the DGP parameters used in the placebo studies of the Sequential Synthetic DiD paper.
simulate_dgp()
Simulates data from DGPs used in the placebo studies of the synthetic difference in differences paper.
randomize_treatment()
Randomize treatment to n units with probability pi then if the number of treated units is zero, assign treatment to one unit uniformly at random and if the number of treated units exceeds a cap, remove treatment uniformly at random so it is exactly that cap
randomize_cohort()
Randomize adoptions date for treated units.

Plots and Tables for simulations

plot_chc_effect()
Plot Figure 1 with effect of CHC on mortality.
create_tables()
Creates 2 tables: RMSE & Bias table and coverage table.
plot_t_stat()
Generate t-statistic plot that compares the emperical t-statistic distribution with the standard normal distribution.
plot_cohorts()
Plot the empirical CDF of simuated adoption dates.

Aggregation functions

aggregate_by_weight()
Weight the estimated effect by cohort weight (population).
aggregate_inv_did_var()
Weight the estimated effect inversely proportional to DiD variance. DiD variance is used instead of SSDiD variance to eliminate potential overfitting.
aggregate_inv_var()
Weight the estimated effect inversely proportional to asymptotic variance.

Auxiliary functions

decompose_Y()
Decompose Y into components F, M, and E. Also computes a set of 'unit factors': the first rank left singular vectors from SVD(Y).
svd_compact()
SVD decomposition of a matrix.
fit_ar2()
Estimate ar2 coefficients from iid time series.
ar2_correlation_matrix()
Compute the correlation matrix of a time series generated by an ar2 model.
cohort_to_adopt_date()
Converts adoption dates from to column names of Y matrix.
print(<sequential_estimate>)
Print a sequential_estimate object
plot(<sequential_estimate>)
Plot estimated treatment effect by lag.
est_names
The list with estimator names. It is created for convenience.
estimation_funcs
unit and cohort level estimation functions.
last_col()
Take the last column of a dataframe or matrix.
default_penalty()
Default regularization function for SSDiD.
remove_adopt_date()
Remove adopt_date column from a dataframe (Y or W).
vec_paste0()
Concatenates the base_string with the numbers from 1 to len.
